chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the shādhakūnah upon which janabah is present: may one pray upon it in the litter? He said: There is no harm.

key_terms.الشَّاذَكُونَةِ: a type of cloth, covering, or padded fabric spread in a conveyance
key_terms.الْجَنَابَةُ: the state or trace of major ritual impurity referred to in the question
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: a litter or riding carriage in which one is carried
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat on a shādhakūnah in a litter if it has janabah on it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning praying on a shādhakūnah in a litter when it has been affected by janabah. Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام rules that there is no problem in praying on it, indicating permissibility in this case.
